name: sgs/icon
title: SGS Icon
description: Icon from multiple sources — Lucide SVG, WordPress icons, Dashicons, or emoji — with size, colour, optional background shape, and optional link.

icon.label: Icon
icon._note: Single-semantic-element block — the root <div> (or <a> when linkUrl is set) IS the icon element (render.php). css:color/background-color map to iconColour/backgroundColour rather than native: paths — render.php steps 3-4 drive the literal colour/shape-fill declarations from these SGS attrs directly. css:padding/margin resolve via the native fallback (isWrapper + spacing support). `backgroundPadding` is a bespoke single-value shape-inset control (Spec 32 §6.1c — deliberately NOT a BoxControl padding family) with no cluster member of its own, same carve-out reasoning as sgs/button's icon element (clusters: []) — left an honest orphan, not force-mapped. iconAlign is a bespoke icon control with no Spec 35 vocabulary member (no align member exists) — left unclaimed. `scaleHover` maps to `css:transform` in the hover attrMap above (fixed 2026-08-28) — the prior note here called it 'deliberately left unclaimed, no scale vocabulary member', which was stale: `css:transform` became a real vocabulary member 2026-07-24 (used by sgs/post-grid and sgs/team-member) and was simply never revisited on this block. No border-width/style/box-shadow/width/height/gap/aspect-ratio attrs on this block — honest gaps. `iconSize` is NOT this element's own attr any more (moved to the new `emoji` element below, 2026-08-15) even though `--sgs-icon-size` ALSO sizes THIS root's width/height (style.css:32-33, every source type) — a genuine one-attr/two-target case the manifest's single-element-per-attr shape cannot represent without dropping one target; `emoji` is the more precise of the two (only ONE source variant reads it as font-size) and matches what real BEM evidence already correctly resolves `css_element` to. `backgroundColourGradient` (2026-09-06, colour-conformance closeout) is a sibling of `backgroundColour`, resolved via `sgs_background_paint_decl()` (helpers-tokens.php) — a DIRECT LITERAL declaration on this block's own `.{uid}` scoped `<style>` rule, not a static-stylesheet custom-property consumer, so style.css needed no matching `background-image:var(...)` line (contrast option-picker/tabs' shape). No effect on the outline shape (border ring only, gated by `$is_outline`, no fill to gradient).

emoji.label: Emoji Glyph
emoji._note: The emoji GLYPH itself when `iconSource='emoji'` (style.css:41-42, `.sgs-icon__emoji{font-size:var(--sgs-icon-size,...)}`) — declared 2026-08-15 (Class 3, session fix: this element previously existed only in real markup/CSS, never in the manifest — an undeclared-sub-element drift the reseed audit flagged as an orphan `css_element`, since `iconSize` already resolved here via real BEM-selector evidence with no manifest backing it). Deliberately NO attrMap: adding one here would collide with `iconSize` staying declared on the `icon` root too (an attr can only carry ONE manifest_hit — see that element's own note), and `iconSize` already resolves correctly via BEM observation without one. svg/dashicon glyphs render as `<span>`/`<svg>` at `width/height:100%` and never reference `--sgs-icon-size` directly — the ROOT's own width/height (icon element) is what sizes them, so this element covers the emoji source variant only, honestly narrower than 'icon'.

backgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the filled background shape via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_background_paint_decl). Non-empty wins over backgroundColour. No effect on the outline shape (border ring only, no fill).

backgroundPadding.description: Padding inside the background shape (circle/pill/rounded/square/outline). Raw CSS length (e.g. 12px, 0.75rem). Empty = theme default (12px). Single uniform value — NOT a 4-side box family (Spec 32 6.1c) — emitted scoped, not inline.

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string (linear-gradient()/radial-gradient()) painting the icon's stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time. Sibling attribute per D636 — see helpers-svg-gradient.php.

iconColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state sibling of iconColourGradient. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.
